description: A Python module defining the Saffron class for recipe integration, including methods to parse recipe files, generate recipe files, and handle multiple recipes within a cooking application.

classes.name: Saffron
classes.description: A class for handling recipe parsing and generation specific to saffron recipes, extending the Integration base class.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Parses a recipe file to extract recipe details, ingredients, and instructions, then creates and saves corresponding database objects.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Generates a text representation of a recipe object suitable for file output.

methods.name: get_files_from_recipes
methods.description: Generates multiple recipe files from a list of recipe objects and updates processing status.
